## Reporting the data as a heatmap
```{r}
mapping_scores <- read.csv("~/Scratch_MF/2026_Falis_et_al/Figure1/1c/Data/SixSpecies_CellTypeWithTrophoblast_MappingScores.txt")
mapping_scores <- mapping_scores %>%
  column_to_rownames("X") %>% 
  as.matrix()

## adjusting species names
colnames(mapping_scores) <- gsub(pattern = "hs_", replacement = "HUM_", x = gsub(pattern = "cj_", replacement = "MAR_", x = gsub(pattern = "oc_", replacement = "RAB_", x = gsub(pattern = "cp_", replacement = "GUI_", x = gsub(pattern = "mm_", replacement = "MOU_", x = gsub(pattern = "rn_", replacement = "RAT_", x = colnames(mapping_scores)))))))
rownames(mapping_scores) <- colnames(mapping_scores)

# Adding row annotation
row_groups <- gsub(pattern = ".*_", replacement = '', x = rownames(mapping_scores))
row_groups <- row_groups %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("cell.type" = ".") %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(cell.type %in% c("Bcells", "Tcells", "uNK", "Hofbauer", "Macrophages", "Monocytes") ~ "Immune", 
                           cell.type %in% c("ParietalYS", "VisceralYS") ~ "Yolk Sac", 
                           cell.type %in% c("Erythroid", "Platelets") ~ "Other Blood Cells", 
                           cell.type %in% c("UterineEp") ~ "Uterine Epithelial", 
                           cell.type %in% c("DSC") ~ "Decidual Stromal Cells", 
                           cell.type %in% c("Endo", "EndoM", "EndoF") ~ "Endothelial", 
                           cell.type %in% c("Pericytes", "Fibroblast", "SMC") ~ "Stromal", 
                           cell.type %in% c("Trophoblast") ~ "Trophoblast")) %>%
  pull(group)
col_groups <- row_groups

group_colors <- c("Immune" = "#1F78B4",
             "Other Blood Cells" = "#6A3D9A",
             "Decidual Stromal Cells" = "#E6AB02",
             "Uterine Epithelial" = "#FFD92F",
             "Endothelial" = "#C71585",
              "Stromal" = "#A6761D",
             "Yolk Sac" = "#969696",
             "Trophoblast" = "#00BFC4")


row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  CellClass = row_groups,
  col = list(CellClass = group_colors), 
  show_legend = FALSE,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

col_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  CellClass = col_groups,
  col = list(CellClass = group_colors),
  show_legend = FALSE,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

p <- Heatmap(
  mapping_scores,
  name = "Mapping Score",
  col = colorRamp2(c(0, 1), c("white", "darkgreen")),
  clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
  clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = TRUE,
  show_row_dend = TRUE,
  right_annotation = row_anno,
  bottom_annotation = col_anno,
  column_names_rot = 90,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 22, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 22),
    color_bar = "continuous",
    border = NA,
    legend_height = unit(6, "cm"),
    legend_width = unit(10, "cm"),
    grid_width = unit(0.6, "cm"),
    title_position = "topcenter",
    direction = "horizontal"))


png("Visuals/1c_SAMap_Heatmap.png", width = 5000, height = 5000, res = 300)
draw(p, padding = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 12), "mm"), heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
dev.off()

## Clean up
rm(list = ls())
```
